init_perplexity_api: initialize a PerplexityAPI wrapper with an API key or config file path
query_perplexity_api: send a single question to the Perplexity API and get a structured response
batch_query_perplexity_api: send multiple questions to the Perplexity API and get a list of responses
load_config_perplexity_api: load Perplexity API configuration settings from a YAML config file
review_perplexity_response: review the PerplexityResponse dataclass that holds response content and raw API data
